facts: The pavilion was installed on June 20, 2022. The open ends face due north and south. The interior was backfilled with local soil.

record: Research by Douglas Noble and Karen Kensek
facts: One foundation panel and two pairs of rotated wall and roof panels form an anticlastic thin-shell structure. The UHPC is approximately two inches thick at its thinnest.
Overall length 42 feet and height 13 feet. Pink concrete uses weathering steel fibre reinforcement. The near-200 diagrid perforations differ in size and shape.
